sections.title: Salads

items.name: House Salad (Mediterranean)
items.description: Spring mix, Marcona almonds, pine nuts, shaved fig bread, Manchego cheese, cherry tomatoes, olives, raisins, cucumbers, red onions with a Muscatel vinaigrette.

items.name: Caprese Salad
items.description: Tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil topped with olive oil, balsamic vinegar and sea salt.

items.name: Ensalada de Palmito (Hearts of Palm)
items.description: Spring mix, hearts of palm, tomatoes, roasted pepper, red onions, topped with crumbled feta cheese and avocadoes. Served with olive oil and balsamic vinegar table side.

items.name: Ensalada Pera Peral (Pears Peral Cheese)
items.description: Spring Mix, sliced pears, dried cranberries, tossed in pear vinaigrette, topped with La Peral blue cheese.

items.name: Ensalada Cesar (Caesar)
items.description: Romaine hearts, homemade Caesar dressing, Manchego cheese and topped with cassava croutons.

notes: Add chicken, shrimp or calamari for $7.00

items.name: Asopado (Rice Soup)
items.description: Paella style soup with Valencia rice, shrimp, Spanish chorizo, chicken and saffron.

items.name: Black Beans
items.description: Available in a cup or a bowl.

items.name: La Peral
items.description: This rare cheese is creamy melt in your mouth quality. It resembles Italian gorgonzola and has strong olive flavor and pungent aroma. Milder than most blue cheese. Served w/ fig marmalade.

items.name: Ibérico
items.description: The smooth texture melts in your tongue with a nutty full bodied flavor and finishes with a fruity after taste. Served w/ port berries.

items.name: Manchego
items.description: The taste is creamy and full bodied and provides a hint of nut and caramel with a light after taste. Served w/ smoked honey.

items.name: Chef’s Selection
items.description: Chef’s selection of three cheeses.

items.name: 18 Month Reserve Serrano Ham
items.description: This ham is world renowned for its meaty, woodsy aroma and a delicate rich flavor.

items.name: Chorizo Los Palacios
items.description: Seasoned with spice smoked paprika from western Spain, it is not flaming hot, but rather spicy.

items.name: Fuet
items.description: A long slender all pork sausage frequently found in Catalonia. Fuet is a dry cured like salami.

items.name: Chef’s Selection
items.description: Chef’s Selection of three meats.

items.name: Italian
items.description: Grilled chicken breast, basil tomatoes fresh mozzarella, pesto sauce, finished with garlic infused extra virgin oil.

items.name: Vegetariano
items.description: Goat cheese, sofrito sauce, tapenade, roasted pepper, herb salad.

items.name: Short Ribs
items.description: Braised short ribs, La Peral blue cheese, caramelized onions and herb salad.

items.name: Mushrooms
items.description: Sun dried tomato Pesto, Crimini and Shiitake, mushrooms, Tetilla cheese, tapenade. Topped with Manchego Cheese snow.

items.name: Queso Fundido (Melted Cheese)
items.description: Melted Spanish Tetilla cheese, topped with crispy chorizo and Serrano ham. Served with Blue Dog bread.

items.name: Queso Dip
items.description: Our Cuban take on this popular appetizer, Cheese sauce topped with Spanish chorizo, pico de gallo, guacamole. Served with tortilla chips.

items.name: Vegetarian Queso Dip
items.description: Topped with black beans, pico de gallo and guacamole.

items.name: Guacamole
items.description: Avocados, tomatoes, cilantro, roasted peppers, red onions and lime juice. Served with plantain chips.

items.name: Trio de Hummus
items.description: Black bean hummus, chickpea hummus and roasted pepper hummus served with olives, almonds, pine nuts, tomatoes, onions, sumac, olive oil and parsley. Served with pita bread.

items.name: Aceitunas Marinadas (Marinated Olives)
items.description: Marinated mixed Spanish olives.

items.name: Piquillo Peppers
items.description: Spanish roasted sweet red peppers stuffed with goat cheese. Topped with crushed Marcona almonds and smoked honey.

items.name: Solomillo al Cabrales
items.description: Grilled beef tenderloin topped with Cabrales blue cheese, Spanish port reduction sauce served over roasted mashed potatoes.

items.name: Tabla de Chimichurri
items.description: Grilled skirt steak served with mashed potatoes, green chimichurri sauce and shredded potato chips.

items.name: Tostones Con Pollo
items.description: Smashed fried green plantains topped with grilled chicken, cheese, romaine lettuce, pico de gallo and sour cream.

items.name: Chuleta de Cordero (Lamb Chops)
items.description: Grilled lamb chops served over our piquillo pepper hummus.

items.name: Rioja Short Ribs
items.description: Rioja wine braised short ribs, served over mashed potatoes with a port wine reduction.

items.name: Datiles Rellenos (Stuffed Dates)
items.description: Roasted stuffed dates with Capriole goat cheese wrapped in apple wood bacon topped with smoked honey and piquillo sauce.

items.name: Albóndigas (Meatballs)
items.description: Spanish style meatballs. Seasoned ground Angus beef, pork and Spanish chorizo. Served in a wine tomato sauce. Topped with Manchego cheese snow.

items.name: Empanadas
items.description: Ground beef, chicken or veggie. Lightly breaded, flaky pastries stuffed and seasoned. Served with chipotle sour cream.

items.name: Croquetas de Jamon
items.description: Serrano ham croquettes served with a Chipotle aioli sauce for dipping on the side.

items.name: Croquetas de Pollo
items.description: Chicken croquettes served with a Chipotle aioli sauce for dipping on the side.

items.name: Pincho de Pollo
items.description: Grilled chicken skewers seasoned w/ Spanish spices, served with piquillo pepper hummus and Alberquina olive oil.

items.name: Ropa Vieja de Pollo
items.description: Shredded chicken seasoned with bell peppers and onions, cooked in a red wine tomato Creole sauce, served over steamed white rice, black beans and sweet plantains.

items.name: Chicken Marsala
items.description: Grilled chicken breast seasoned w/Spanish spices topped with a savory sauce of mushrooms, garlic, marsala wine and Manchego cheese snow. Served over mashed potatoes.

items.name: Tenderloin Skewers
items.description: Grilled fillet Mignon skewers served over mashed potatoes, topped with red chimichurri sauce.

items.name: Gambas al Ajillo (Garlic Shrimp)
items.description: Plump shrimp sautéed with garlic, olive oil and finished with lime juice. Served with garlic aioli, fresh salsa and bread.

items.name: Mejillones al Sofrito (Mussels)
items.description: Blue Mussels sautéed with olive oil, tomatoes, garlic, onions, finished with wine and cilantro. Served with Blue Dog bread.

items.name: Calamares a la Romana (Fried Calamari)
items.description: Rings, tentacles, olives and roasted peppers dusted in a seasoned flour and fried until crispy. Served with garlic aioli and sweet chili sauce.

items.name: Pescadillo Frito (Fried fish)
items.description: Breaded fried white fish strips served with garlic aioli.

items.name: Croquetas de Mariscos (Seafood Croquettes)
items.description: Shrimp, crawfish, crabmeat, white fish croquettes. Served with avocado aioli.

items.name: Zarzuela de Mariscos
items.description: Traditional Spanish aromatic seafood stew cooked in Spanish clay casserole with combination of shrimp, white fish, calamari, mussels, clams and scallops in a tomato sauce. Served with Blue Dog bread. (Good for two people)

items.name: Fish Tacos
items.description: Breaded white fish lightly fried.

items.name: Steak Tacos
items.description: Grilled beef tenderloin strips.

items.name: Pork
items.description: Served over corn tortillas, topped with our house made guacamole, fresh salsa, sour cream, red papadews, peppers, onions and cilantro. Served with tomatillo or chimichurri sauce.

items.name: Chicken
items.description: Served over corn tortillas, topped with our house made guacamole, fresh salsa, sour cream, red papadews, peppers, onions and cilantro. Served with tomatillo or chimichurri sauce.

items.name: Vegetables
items.description: Served over corn tortillas, topped with our house made guacamole, fresh salsa, sour cream, red papadews, peppers, onions and cilantro. Served with tomatillo or chimichurri sauce.

items.name: Quesadillas
items.description: Served in flour tortillas with Monterey jack cheese, fresh salsa, sour cream and a side of homemade queso dip (available).

sections.title: Vegetarianos (Vegetarian)

items.name: Boniato Frito (Sweet Potato Fries)
items.description: Sweet potato fries. Served with our popular homemade smoked honey.

items.name: Patatas Bravas (Spicy Potatoes)
items.description: Fried Potatoes with spicy tomato sauce topped with aioli and Manchego cheese.

items.name: Veggie Empanadas
items.description: Spinach, corn, peppers, onions and cheese.

items.name: Gratinado de Setas (Mushrooms Au Gratin)
items.description: Au Gratin of Crimini, Portobello and Shiitake mushrooms, truffle oil, potatoes, roasted garlic, capriole goat cheese, Tetilla cheese. Served with Blue Dog bread.

items.name: Grilled Vegetables
items.description: Zucchini, squash, red onions, bell peppers and mushrooms sauteed with sofrito sauce and topped with snow manchego cheese.

notes: Notice: Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of food borne illness.

items.name: Pescado (Fish Sandwich)
items.description: White fish, spicy aioli, chopped tomatoes, lettuce, red onions and avocadoes. Served on a gourmet bun.

items.name: Frita de Mariscos (Seafood Burger)
items.description: Crabmeat, shrimp, crawfish, and white fish seasoned with Cuban spices, bell peppers, onions and garlic. Served on a gourmet bun with lettuce, slice tomato, red onions and topped with lime avocado aioli.

items.name: Sandwich Cubano (Cuban Sandwich)
items.description: Roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard, served on a hot pressed Cuban bread.

items.name: Frita Cubana (Cuban Burger)
items.description: A mix of Black Angus beef, Spanish chorizo and Cuban spices. Served on a gourmet bun with lettuce, tomatoes and onions. Topped with crispy Serrano ham, Swiss cheese and potato strings.

items.name: De Lomito (Tenderloin Sandwich)
items.description: Grilled beef tenderloin, grilled onions, Swiss cheese and potato strings. Served on a gourmet bun with lettuce and tomatoes.

items.name: Sandwich de Pollo (Chicken Sandwich)
items.description: Grilled chicken, apple wood bacon, Swiss cheese, baby arugula, tomato, honey aioli.

items.name: Sandwich de Milanesa
items.description: Lightly breaded chicken breast fried. Topped with Serrano ham and provolone cheese on a gourmet bun over sofrito sauce, lettuce and red onions.

items.name: Sandwich de Vegetales
items.description: Grilled eggplant, piquillo peppers, zucchini, squash, mushrooms, onions, tomatoes, provolone cheese and roasted pepper cream cheese. Served on a hot pressed Cuban bread.

items.name: Havana Club
items.description: Grilled chicken, ham, bacon, Swiss cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and honey mustard on hot pressed Cuban bread.

items.name: Havana Rumba
items.description: Roasted pork, spanish chorizo, serrano ham, provolone cheese, ham, mustard, pickles and aioli. Served on hot pressed Cuban bread.

items.name: Trio de Chocolate
items.description: Chocolate custard, Milk chocolate ice cream, Chocolate mousse, topped with banana brûlée.

items.name: Flan de queso de Cabra
items.description: Goat cheese flan with Cajeta ice cream and almond brittle.

items.name: Pudin de banana
items.description: Banana bread pudding served over dark Spanish chocolate sauce topped with house made vanilla bean ice cream.

items.name: Cuban Flan
items.description: Vanilla custard, served with vanilla ice cream.

items.name: Cake de Bombón
items.description: Cuban-style chocolate cake, served with vanilla ice cream.

items.name: Soft Drinks
items.description: Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Mr. Pibb, Pink Lemonade, Fanta Orange

items.name: Café con Leche
items.description: Cuban coffee with extra steamed milk. Great for after dinner.

items.name: Café Cubano
items.description: Flavorful Cuban coffee, served sweetened. Strong enough to keep you dancing all night. Decaf also available.

items.name: Cortadito
items.description: Cuban coffee with a shot of steamed milk and sugar, for those not brave enough for the Cuban coffee straight up.

items.name: Americano
items.description: Regular or Decaf. Available for those that we haven’t converted to Cuban coffee, yet. Each cup made fresh to order. No Free Refills, sorry.
